name: Reproduced Any-to-Bokeh-style 200-video Test Set

renderer.name: MPIB-public proxy
renderer.identity: Not proven identical to private Any-to-Bokeh ModuleRenderRT

metrics.PSNR: mean per-frame, plus mean clip-pooled-MSE PSNR
metrics.FD: torchvision RAFT-large C_T_SKHT_V2 mean L1 flow difference,24 transitions
metrics.RM: mean absolute difference of frame differences,24 transitions
metrics.grouping: equal weight per scene; also groups by fixed K
metrics.scope: non-held-out public proxy reproduction; paper numbers external reference only

paper_reference.scope: External reference; not same test samples/renderer/evaluation details

differences: 200 base scenes and one fixed focus-object variant each; public script currently 300 bases with four focus variants
AM train FG treated as fixed asset, not physical color ground truth; no recovery
VM HEVC decoded at stride 4; max long side 1920 for JPEG-HD-like source size, not identical JPEG files
BG-20k train replaces undisclosed BG_test; official validation/test pools untouched
Seed 20 plus scene ID defines independent deterministic NumPy/Torch streams instead of process-dependent RNG
Public crop alpha>128, scale0.5..0.8, rotate-10..10, grid2x2 random-walk placements retained, including crop/border limitations
Uses official public MPIB ray generator as a proxy for missing author kernel; no claim of exact identity
sRGB-space AIF and ray integration based on visible public generator path; private kernel gamma remains unverified
PNG8 lossless RGB/GT and rounded PNG8 disparity instead of author JPEG; no per-scene normalization
Geometry, sources and focus/K identical to valid-inputs manifest; no adaptation to model scores
limits: Natural train foregrounds are fixed composition assets, not physical color GT
Not strict held-out; no assertion that author checkpoint never saw materials
MPIB public kernel not proven identical to private author kernel
Raw PNG scored, not author JPEG/MP4 chain
RM evaluates all24 transitions; public metrics code derives count from channel dimension before flattening and may evaluate only2 for B,C,T,H,W input
No FVD/VFID or standardized efficiency claim
Foreground composition groups are mutually exclusive descriptive statistics; repeated source assets and differing K/focus/content prevent independent or causal difficulty claims.
inference: Official checkpoint,8-frame windows,overlap4,batch2,num_steps1,seed0,full1024x576; unmodified author model code

resume_record.reason: Connection/turn interruption; no running Python jobs found on recovery

selection.selection: First two manifest scenes for each K, chosen before examining model scores

findings: No obvious frame-order, missing-layer or gross focus-object mismatch in inspected RGB/GT/prediction panels.
Expected source-crop hard cuts and rectangular partial-body boundaries are visible; retained public-generator-style limitation, not an E6-style complete-foreground benchmark.

K4/8 weaker and K16/32 stronger defocus are visible in the selected conditions, with broadly matching GT/prediction appearance. This is not a controlled K-only comparison because scene content and focus differ.
limits: Keyframe review only, not manual review of all5000frames or all temporal transitions.
No source selection or parameter change based on scores.
Agreement with proxy GT is not physical accuracy or equivalence to author private renderer.

additional_visual_review.selection: Post-score diagnostic only; no scene removal or parameter changes
observations: Inspected RGB/GT/prediction positions remain aligned; no obvious missing-layer or frame-order error in sampled keyframes.
Strong-defocus foreground overlap and high-frequency zebra texture are present in low-PSNR repro_068.
repro_092 contains strongly blurred background/other layers and a moving sharp bear; sampled keyframes do not uniquely attribute elevated FD to model flicker rather than flow-estimation sensitivity.
Raw source crop cuts remain visible and are retained as a generator limitation.
additional_visual_review.limits: Additional20keyframes, combined with preselected40keyframes; not manual review of every frame or every transition.

author_public_metrics_recalculation: Pending; TorchMetrics PSNR/SSIM, public-code FD/RM crosscheck and FVD/VFID-I plan preserved; no extra model inference required.
